id: title:Gilbert09:stop errors sync crashing at pagination ceiling

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion resilience against pagination API limits
review.reason: Adds a new function `_fetch_list_list_page_or_stop` and its integration into pagination loops (`_iter_top_level`, `_iter_fan_out`) to handle HTTP 422 errors on subsequent pages. This could prevent warehouse ingestion failures when BugSnag's API returns a pagination cursor beyond its depth ceiling, allowing the warehouse ingestion to continue with collected rows instead of failing.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the pagination ceiling handling; P1.F1.H3 and P1.F2.H1 are not shown. The benefit relies on the assumption that BugSnag's API returns a 422 error for pagination cursors beyond its depth ceiling, which is not verified. The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of the error handling and its integration, not on
